title: hive answer-digest output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive answer-digest --json`. The success envelope reports whether a Telegram digest of human-blocking tasks was sent (sent/reason/dry_run/chat_id), the attached button count, and the full waiting set (count/tasks) so an agent can learn how many and which tasks wait even on a real send where message is null. `--dry-run --json` is side-effect-free (loads no .env, resolves no chat/token, sends nothing) — the read path for an agent. Error conditions emit the ErrorPayload: a bad --date / missing chat (Hive::ConfigError, error_kind=config, exit 78) and a status outage (StatusUnavailableError, error_kind=status_unavailable, exit 69) via the in-command envelope, and a malformed invocation (error_kind=usage, exit 64) via JSON_USAGE_ERROR_CONTRACTS (Thor) or the in-command envelope (programmatic call). A Telegram send error mid-delivery (a non-Hive transport fault) is wrapped in Hive::InternalError (error_kind=internal, exit 70) and re-raised after the ErrorPayload is emitted.

date.description: The local calendar date echoed from --date (or today's local date). Does not scope the (always-live) waiting set or dedup sends; scheduler idempotency lives in answer_digest_state.json.

sent.description: true only when a Telegram message was actually sent (reason is null). Derived from reason.

reason.description: null = a digest was sent; empty = nothing was waiting, so nothing was sent; dry_run = the digest was rendered but not sent (--dry-run).

dry_run.description: true when invoked with --dry-run; nothing was sent to Telegram.

chat_id.description: The Telegram chat the digest was sent to (the first bot.chat_id_allowlist entry). null when nothing was sent (empty/dry_run).

button_count.description: The number of inline buttons rendered for the digest — attached to the sent message, or (on a --dry-run) that WOULD be attached — capped at the 10-task display cap. Use `count` for the true total.

count.description: The true number of tasks waiting on human input (uncapped).

tasks.description: One entry per waiting task, in delivery order. Present even on a real send (where message is null).

message.description: The rendered digest text on a --dry-run (so a caller can preview it); null on a real send and on an empty waiting set.

id.description: The numeric task id, when assigned.

title.description: The display title (`#<id> <name>`, name, or slug-derived fallback).

stage.description: The current stage directory the task waits in.

pr.description: The `#<number>` pull-request label when a PR exists, else null.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the error class that was raised.

error_kind.description: usage = malformed invocation (bad flag / unexpected arg), exit 64. config = bad --date / missing chat config (Hive::ConfigError), exit 78. status_unavailable = `hive status --json` came back unusable (StatusUnavailableError), exit 69, retryable. internal = an untyped fault wrapped in Hive::InternalError, exit 70.
